integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the block-basis transfer from WMP to weakly singular maximizing sequences and checks every inherited implication and sharp negative model against the cited primary source. No computational or probabilistic approximation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns \(1<p<\infty\) and finite \(r\). Below \(p^*\), arbitrary codomains are not classified. The exact perturbation threshold additionally assumes WMP and an isometric copy of \(\ell_p\) in the codomain; no statement is made for merely isomorphic containment.
title: Above the conjugate exponent, WMP and SMP coincide on \(\ell_p\) domains
